angleRead.text: I want to put one question to the record before anyone reads the C97 headline as settled: what exactly was built at the Fruitvale site, under which authorization, and whether any of it is Phase II design work the council has held. Then I want the answer in writing. Here's what we know: the tracker holds design advancement, schematics are not evidenced, and the comment-and-response record is missing. Here's what we don't know: whether the site work at C97 falls inside or outside the held design scope. I will ask Transit Hub planning first, then the District 3 office, and I will not characterize the C97 piece as an error until the scope is documented either way.
